## POST `/api/2.58/fleets`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Creates a fleet and adds the current array as its first member. Additional arrays can be added to the fleet with `POST /fleets/members`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `names` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the unique resource names specified. Only one value is supported. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `FleetResponse`

## DELETE `/api/2.58/fleets`

**Tier:** T3  

Deletes a fleet, permanently. A fleet can only be deleted if the current array is the only array in the fleet.

**Responses:** `200` OK

## POST `/api/2.58/fleets/fleet-key`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)

## POST `/api/2.58/fleets/members`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Adds arrays to an existing fleet. This API needs to be run from the array that's joining the fleet. To add the current array to the fleet, specify its own array `id` or `name`, as well as the `fleet key` generated on any array already in the fleet. `resource_type` is `remote-arrays`. The array's `ID` and `name` can be retrieved with a call to `GET /arrays` on the array.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | header | string |  | Access token (in JWT format) required to use any API endpoint (except `/oauth2`, `/login`, and `/logout`) |
| `X-Request-ID` | header | string |  | Supplied by client during request or generated by server. |
| `fleet_ids` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the unique Fleet IDs specified. This query currently accepts only 1 ID. |
| `fleet_names` | query | array of string |  | Performs the operation on the unique Fleet names specified. Enter multiple names in comma-separated format. For example, `name01,name02`. This query currently accepts only 1 name. |

**Request body** (optional): `FleetMemberPost`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `members` | array of `_fleetmemberpostMembers` | Info about the members being added to fleet. |

**Responses:** `200` OK → `FleetMemberResponse`

## DELETE `/api/2.58/fleets/members`

**Tier:** T3  

Deletes the specified array(s) from the fleet. Note that this will only succeed if the array(s) to be removed are not making use of any fleet resources.
